text:
This controls the creation of the enhanced mode API that
returns information about the previous mode and the next
mode. If set to "true" the enhanced mode API is
supposed to be generated. For more details please refer
to the SWS_RTE.

targets.why: Creation of enhancedModeApi for mode switch
enhancedModeApi attribute in BSW mode policies
enhancedModeApi attribute controls enhanced mode API
